starbridge ask \
  --question 'Fix the red CI by changing roundCents to round half up, as accounting asked yesterday?' \
  --context 'CI on main is red: the test accounting added yesterday expects roundCents(1.005) to give 1.01, but float math gives 1.00 (1.005*100 is 100.49999...).
Fix to half-up: CI goes green; invoice totals on x.xx5 amounts can change by up to half a cent.
Skip test for now: CI goes green but invoices keep today's rounding and accounting's request stays unmet.' \
  --option 'Fix to half-up' --option 'Skip test for now' \
  --recommended 'Fix to half-up' \
  --waiting
